jobs.prompt:
Goal g-33a7a4ae, D-fix batch 26h (logging-only visibility round). Read docs/state/silent-failures.md methodology (top) and the sections for the files below. Edit ONLY: tools/board-run.mjs, tools/deploy-status.mjs, tools/machine-limit.mjs, tools/orchestrator-up.mjs, tools/release-train-bump.mjs, tools/split-scan.mjs, tools/time-auto.mjs, tools/watch-gallery.mjs. Visibility only: do NOT change control flow, return values, fallbacks, throws, or exports. No refactors or reformatting.

Line numbers below are CURRENT (verified against origin/swarm/train3). For each listed catch, bind the error and do exactly what the line says:
- SILENT-<CODE>: stay silent when error?.code === '<CODE>' (or the named class, e.g. SyntaxError); console.error anything else. Keep the same fallback value.
- LEAVE: make NO change to that catch at all.
- LOG-ALWAYS: console.error unconditionally, include the path/id named, keep the same fallback value.
- For `.catch(() => null)` / `.catch(() => '')` forms, keep returning the same value from inside the new handler.
- A close/cleanup inside an error path that rethrows: log the cleanup error with a DIFFERENT binding name; the original error must still be rethrown unchanged.

### tools/board-run.mjs
Logger prefix: console.error('[tools/board-run.mjs] <short context>:', error?.message ?? error)
- Line 65 `catch { /* an old run may have no manifest */ }`: SILENT-ENOENT — old runs lack manifest.json as the comment says, but a corrupt one must log fixed text 'corrupt manifest.json (SyntaxError)', never the raw JSON.parse message.

### tools/deploy-status.mjs
Logger prefix: console.error('[tools/deploy-status.mjs] <short context>:', error?.message ?? error)
- Line 55 `catch { /* missing or unreadable git config */ }`: SILENT-ENOENT/EACCES — githubRepo() is a best-effort probe of .git/config for a status display; not every root is a git repo with a readable config.

### tools/machine-limit.mjs
Logger prefix: console.error('[tools/machine-limit.mjs] <short context>:', error?.message ?? error)
- Line 242 `try { return createLaneCaps.fromJSON(state.laneCaps, ...) }`: LOG-ALWAYS — no error is expected from reparsing already-validated persisted laneCaps; silently falling through hides corrupt autotune state.

### tools/orchestrator-up.mjs
Logger prefix: console.error('[tools/orchestrator-up.mjs] <short context>:', error?.message ?? error)
- Line 58 `fs.accessSync(p, fs.constants.X_OK); return p`: SILENT-ENOENT/EACCES/ENOTDIR — PATH probe for an executable; most PATH dirs won't have it, log anything else.

### tools/release-train-bump.mjs
Logger prefix: console.error('[tools/release-train-bump.mjs] <short context>:', error?.message ?? error)
- Line 104 `await fs.unlink(tmp).catch(() => {})`: SILENT-ENOENT — tmp cleanup after a failed wx write/rename; the tmp file often never got created, so ENOENT is expected, log any other unlink failure since it'd leave a stray tmp file.

### tools/split-scan.mjs
Logger prefix: console.error('[tools/split-scan.mjs] <short context>:', error?.message ?? error)
- Line 776 `const { ast, comments } = parseSource(text)`: LOG-ALWAYS — scans tools/swarm.mjs's own (valid) source for split points; a parse failure here isn't expected, so silently caching empty opaque-ranges can quietly make the splitter treat string/comment contents as split-eligible; log the parse error instead.

### tools/time-auto.mjs
Logger prefix: console.error('[tools/time-auto.mjs] <short context>:', error?.message ?? error)
- Line 48 `for await (const line of rl) { ... }`: SILENT-ENOENT — the file was just listed by readdir so a race-deleted transcript is the plausible benign cause; log anything else since it would silently drop real owner-activity signal.

### tools/watch-gallery.mjs
Logger prefix: console.error('[tools/watch-gallery.mjs] <short context>:', error?.message ?? error)
- Line 160 `await unlink(tmp).catch(() => {})`: SILENT-ENOENT — same tmp-cleanup-before-rethrow pattern as lesson-store/release-train; tmp may never have been created, log any other unlink failure.

Do NOT touch any other catch. FORBIDDEN shortcut patterns (rejected in review): `catch (e) { e; }`, `.catch((_e) => ...)` never logged, `void error`, any binding not used in a real check or console.error.

Then grep tests/ for each file's basename and run those tests with: node --import ./tests/_isolate-config.mjs --test <files>; confirm green. Final summary: one line per flagged line.
